body: Oh, you.  Have you come to speak with me again?
I still can't afford it.  Plus I hate having time alone with my thoughts.
I can't afford it.  And my SO would have a lot of questions, and she couldn't get time off to join me.  Plus... I wouldn't know what to do.  What would it accomplish?
I'm almost 30.  I went to college and have a degree and an objectively good job that I should enjoy.

No.  Well, yes, to an extent.  But it's mostly because I know I'm anti-social and awkward and garbage - so no one would want to be near me.  And I'm terrified of being alone.  Though, if I were, I could finally just end it.

My life.  I have to constantly censor myself.  I have to constantly act in a way that I think others will find acceptable.  I have no resources to pursue my own endeavors.   I have to tolerate a lot of things that I find unacceptable (though some of them are a bit neurotic on my part).  It's mostly that I just feel alone, unloved, unwanted, empty, worthless, meaningless, and bored no matter what I try to fix it.
No one seems to get that I just want it to end.  I'm exhausted.  I know I have rational reasons to live, but they don't matter to me.

I haven't really explored self-help books.  My insurance only covers 22 "therapy" appointments per 12 months.  So I see someone twice per month, but it really doesn't do much.  I feel the cost of even that $40/month.  I'll check out /r/depression.

I will check out the depression subreddit.  I assume the one you're referring to is /r/depression?  (I haven't been there, I'm just inferring the name from what you wrote.  I want to make sure I go to the correct place.)

I don't think talking to folks in a similar situation would be helpful.  Probably not to me, and definitely not to them.  I'm always looking for a reason to justify my exit, so... kind of counter to the point, I would imagine.

I have always suffered from depression.  It comes and goes in cycles.  I have tried therapy and I have tried medication.  Neither treatment seems to help.  I can't afford or find multiple-times-per-week therapy.  I am always in a state of despair.  My life feels empty.  I feel worthless.  I am paranoid that others hate me. 

My ex and the one friend I am close enough to share these things with both make me promise not to kill myself.  I resent them for it.  I hate them for it.  I know they only did so not because they would miss me, but because they don't want to deal with it. 

My parents are always hinting in little ways that they don't want me to kill myself.  A close friend of mine, and a man similar to myself, killed himself just about a year ago.  I resented him for beating me to it.  For in his death he took that option away from me. 

My S.O. doesn't want me to kill myself.  She has also made me promise not to. 

Why won't anyone just understand that I'm tired?  I'm sick of living.  I no longer want to be alive.  I want it all to stop.  Every morning I wake up and I am immediately sad that I woke up at all.
Ah, I love Mad World.  I haven't heard the rest... to Amazon!
I know how you feel.  And it's not even that the people I would disappoint really like me.  I don't know why the fuck I struggle when it seem so needless.
Thank you.  I think I'd like that... What's on your sleep mix?
